title: Property Management Admin
description: Admin dashboard for managing property inventory catalog with CRUD operations. Image upload to Vercel Blob, property status tracking, photo section assignment. Static auth via env variables. Dashboard with tabs for Properties, Stats, Hero photos.

inScope: CRUD operations for property inventory catalog
Image upload to Vercel Blob for property photos
Admin selects which photos appear in each section (Hero, Showcase)
Dashboard tabs: Properties, Stats, Hero photos

acceptanceCriteria.text: Admin can log in using env-stored credentials
Admin can create, read, update, delete property listings
Admin can upload property photos to Vercel Blob
Admin can set property status: available, sold, rented
Admin can assign photos to Hero and Showcase sections
Admin can edit company stats (properties sold, clients, years, success rate)
Dashboard has tabbed interface: Properties, Stats, Hero
